title: Document AUTO_PRD_* environment variables
overview:
Users must read source code to discover available environment variables.

**Motivation:** Improves discoverability of configuration options.

**Signals:** priority: low
problem_statement: Users must read source code to discover available environment variables.
resolution_notes: Already implemented. docs/OPERATIONS.md contains comprehensive documentation of all AUTO_PRD_* environment variables (lines 189-237), including: executor policy vars (AUTO_PRD_EXECUTOR_*), security vars (AUTO_PRD_SAFE_SCRIPT_DIRS, AUTO_PRD_ALLOW_UNSAFE_EXECUTION), timeout vars (AUTO_PRD_CODEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, AUTO_PRD_CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), and utility vars (AUTO_PRD_STRICT, AUTO_PRD_ROOT, etc.). Each var has description, valid values, and defaults documented.
